'''Spice liquor''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. [[Horch]] of [[Kheedar]] imbibed copious amounts of spice liquor while under the control of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Noval Garaint]].
